email-address-encoder.quickAnswer: Publishing a plain email address on a website invites spam bots that scan page source for the @ symbol. Encoding replaces each character with an HTML entity like h, which browsers render normally but simple bots cannot read. This tool generates five encoded versions, including a clickable mailto snippet and a JavaScript version.
